title: Age Checker
brief: Build a smart program that checks an age and decides what to say. You'll use if, elif, and else — the decision-making magic from Module 2!
steps: Make a variable called age with any number you like.
If the age is 13 or more, print "You are a teenager!".
Run it, then try changing the age to test both messages.

checks.label: It prints one of the two messages

successMessage: Nice! Your program makes its own decisions now. 🚦 That's the power of if/else!
